metadata.name: Dead Reel
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A co-op creature-survival night in an abandoned theatre. Hold the lobby as the things come over the courtyard walls, clear the foyer, take the auditorium, throw the power on the stage and survive a minute of everything the theatre has — then escape through the projection booth behind the curtain.

objectives.text: Throw the power on the stage
Survive until the projector warms up

do.text: They are coming over the courtyard walls. Hold the lobby!
The lobby doors give way. Something is moving in the foyer.
The lobby doors give way. Something is moving in the foyer.
The auditorium. Get to the stage.
The power switch is on the stage, stage right.
Power is on! The projector needs a minute. Survive!
The booth is open. Behind the curtain, go!
You made it out. The End.
The things have the theatre. Game over.
